methods.new_speech: HeyGen same ACTIVE voice ID as grade 4, ISO zh, speed 0.85, no model override; retained lossless originals with decoded PCM equality; each sentence aligned by Chinese CTC and cut at measured quiet boundaries.
methods.reuse: Exact text plus normalized tone-marked pinyin matched; source manifest, source file SHA256 and base commit retained.
methods.ctc: jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-chinese-zh-cn at 99ccb2737be22b8bb50dcfcc39ad4d567fb90cfd; individual final files greedily recognized without expected-text prompt.
methods.whisper: faster-whisper small int8; native chunks without expected-text prompt; individual final followups for CTC differences or incomplete source coverage.
methods.orthographic_review: 高兴地 uses de from the displayed pinyin; ASR 的(de), 他/她(ta) and traditional 高興 do not establish a pronunciation error.

limitations.details: 직접 청음 검수는 수행하지 못했습니다. 자동 인식·구간 정렬·파일·브라우저 재생 검사는 모든 성조·경성·얼화 및 자연스러움을 보증하지 않습니다. 인식 차이를 확정된 오독으로 간주하지 않습니다.
